scenes.head: BINANCE GOT HACKED
scenes.narration: Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange, just lost about six point three billion dollars.

scenes.head: THE BIGGEST HACK EVER
scenes.narration: Reports call it the biggest crypto hack ever, more than four times the old record.

scenes.head: HOW IT HAPPENED
scenes.narration: Early findings point to a hacked engineer's laptop. Binance says no private keys leaked. Analysts suspect North Korea, unconfirmed.

scenes.head: WITHDRAWALS PAUSED
scenes.narration: Binance paused withdrawals. It says it expects them back within 48 hours.

scenes.head: $3B ALREADY FROZEN
scenes.narration: About three billion dollars has already been frozen on-chain, mostly by Tether and Circle.

scenes.head: ARE YOUR FUNDS SAFE?
scenes.narration: Binance says user funds are safe, and it will cover losses. That is a promise, not a guarantee.

scenes.head: WATCH OUT FOR SCAMS
scenes.narration: Now expect scams: fake refund emails and recovery links. Never click them. Use only the official app.

scenes.head: THE LESSON
scenes.narration: The lesson: on an exchange, they hold your keys. Know the risk, and turn on 2FA.

scenes.head: ONE CRYPTO BASIC A DAY
scenes.foot: Reports as of Oct 30. Developing story. Not financial advice.
